slides.title: Fronting for emphasis
slides.subtitle: Strange as it may seem… / Try as I might…
goals: Move elements to the front for emphasis.
Use concessive fronting: **adjective + as + subject + verb**.

head: Pattern
Example
rows: **Strange as it may seem**, I enjoy exams.
**Try as I might**, I couldn't open it.
**Much as** I like him, I can't lend him money.
**So successful was** the event that it was repeated.

items.q: ___ as it may sound, it's true.
___ as I might, I couldn't remember.
___ as I love my job, I need a break.
